router_body:
name: plan
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - name: full job set selected
        if: ${{ github.event_name != 'pull_request' || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'full-matrix') || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'ci') || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'release-matrix') }}
        run: echo 'SELECTED plan-test linux macos tier'
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        if: ${{ github.event_name != 'pull_request' || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'full-matrix') || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'ci') || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'release-matrix') }}
      - name: local gate wiring proof
        if: ${{ github.event_name != 'pull_request' || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'full-matrix') || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'ci') || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'release-matrix') }}
        run: python3 -I ci/local-gate-test.py
      - name: local evidence gate
        if: ${{ !(github.event_name != 'pull_request' || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'full-matrix') || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'ci') || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'release-matrix')) }}
        run: echo 'Local gauntlet evidence is the gate; request ci or full-matrix for CI.'

ci.yml.plan-test:
name: the planner's own test
    needs: plan
    if: contains(fromJSON(needs.plan.outputs.jobs || '[]'), 'plan-test')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: python3 ci/tiers-test.py
ci.yml.linux:
name: linux x86-64 (every gate)
    needs: plan
    if: contains(fromJSON(needs.plan.outputs.jobs || '[]'), 'linux')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 45
    env:
      ASPEN_ENGINE: docker
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: the pinned toolchain, by digest
        run: tools/fetch-toolchain

      - name: wolf fmt --check
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        run: tools/check-fmt

      - name: build, both tiers
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        run: tools/build --all

      - name: the unit tests, checked machine (fallbacks rerun, wolf-lang#817), native, lupin
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        run: tools/check-test

      - name: C aspen at aspen.pin, its tree clean
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        run: |
          tools/fetch-c-aspen
          test -z "$(git -C .oracle/c-aspen status --porcelain --untracked-files=no)"

      - name: the oracle's container (tree 2.3.2-1 by sha256), and C aspen built in it
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        run: |
          tools/in-container 'tree --version; id'
          tools/in-container 'cd .oracle/c-aspen && ./configure >/dev/null && make -s && ./aspen --version'

      - name: the oracle on the fixtures, native tier
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        run: tools/in-container tools/oracle --bin target/native/aspen

      - name: the oracle on the fixtures, release tier
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        run: tools/in-container tools/oracle --bin target/release/aspen

      - name: C aspen's golden suite against aspen, release tier (the oracle of record)
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        run: tools/in-container tools/golden --bin target/release/aspen

      - name: the differential fuzzer, C aspen's generator and whole flag pool
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        run: tools/in-container tools/fuzz --bin target/release/aspen --n 200

      - name: --asp-diff against C aspen itself (tree has none)
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        run: tools/in-container "tools/aspdiff --bin $PWD/target/release/aspen --c-bin $PWD/.oracle/c-aspen/aspen"

      - name: en_US.UTF-8, every differing golden case by collation alone
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        run: tools/in-container tools/collation --bin target/release/aspen

      - name: the perf rows, the listing and -s within 2x of C aspen (taskset -c 0-3)
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        run: tools/in-container tools/perf --bin target/release/aspen

      - name: the static x86-64 build, twice, and its digest (PAX)
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        run: tools/mkaspen target/mkaspen

      - name: the oracle on the static binary
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        run: tools/in-container tools/oracle --bin target/mkaspen/aspen

      - name: the harnesses see a difference (the standing reds)
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        run: tools/in-container tools/selftest target/release/aspen
ci.yml.macos:
name: macOS arm64
    needs: plan
    if: contains(fromJSON(needs.plan.outputs.jobs || '[]'), 'macos')
    runs-on: macos-latest
    timeout-minutes: 40
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: the pinned toolchain, by digest
        run: tools/fetch-toolchain

      - name: build, both tiers
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        run: tools/build --all

      - name: the unit tests, checked machine, native, lupin
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        run: tools/check-test

      - name: the oracle, from Homebrew (tree 2.3.2)
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        run: |
          brew install tree
          tree --version
          tree --version | grep -q '^tree v2\.3\.2 '

      - name: C aspen at aspen.pin, built
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        run: |
          tools/fetch-c-aspen
          test -z "$(git -C .oracle/c-aspen status --porcelain --untracked-files=no)"
          cd .oracle/c-aspen && ./configure >/dev/null && make -s && ./aspen --version

      # macOS has no container: the runner is an ephemeral VM, and the
      # fixtures' FIFO and socket are Linux-only (tests/fixtures/mkfixtures)
      - name: the oracle on the fixtures, release tier
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        run: tools/oracle --bin target/release/aspen

      - name: C aspen's golden suite against aspen, release tier
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        run: tools/golden --bin target/release/aspen

      - name: the differential fuzzer, the whole pool
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        run: tools/fuzz --bin target/release/aspen --n 100

      - name: --asp-diff against C aspen itself
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        run: tools/aspdiff --bin "$PWD/target/release/aspen" --c-bin "$PWD/.oracle/c-aspen/aspen"
ci.yml.tier:
name: tier ${{ needs.plan.outputs.tier || 'unplanned' }}
    if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
    needs:
      - plan
      - plan-test
      - linux
      - macos
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: every chosen job succeeded, every other was skipped
        env:
          NEEDS: ${{ toJSON(needs) }}
        run: python3 ci/tiers.py verdict

  # A red nightly opens an issue (ruling #92): a scheduled run has no lane
  # watching it, so the red has to come and find one. One open issue per
  # workflow, its title the dedupe key (ci/nightly-red.sh).
ci.yml.nightly-red:
name: nightly red, an issue
    needs: tier
    if: ${{ failure() && github.event_name == 'schedule' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    permissions:
      contents: read
      issues: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: open or update the nightly-red issue
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
          WORKFLOW: ${{ github.workflow }}
          RUN_URL: ${{ github.server_url }}/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${{ github.run_id }}
        run: ci/nightly-red.sh
